altText: Wider view of Taylor Swift in a full-skirted sparkling gown with a blue acoustic guitar, performing Speak Now at the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, under purple lights.
body: in 2011 i wanted to live inside a Speak Now ballgown. that tour was a costume change for every song, and the purple title-track gown is still the image the era lives in. then the ballgown came back for Eras and i melted all over again 💜 https://www.longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
why: November make-good for the Runway thread hero killed with PR #6804; calendar reuses the Speak Now tour gowns subject. Fact from supabase/seed/lenses/runway-looks.mjs look-speak-now. Photo taken from the speak-now era pool (photoEra) instead of the beat's Red-era GMA pick, because the calendar names era speak-now and a Red GMA photo would not earn its place on a gown post. Share hook: which gown is yours. X written first, as its own post.

critique.rationale: Opens on the fairytale pull of the Speak Now ballgowns, then the sourced fact from the Runway lens: a costume change per song on the 2011-2012 tour, the purple title-track gown as the era's image. The Eras Speak Now gown photo is the callback the post turns on.
